description: This is a test class for the IndexLengthRestrictionEnforcer component, part of the persistence layer in the 'thingsearch' service. It verifies behavior related to enforcing length restrictions on index keys and values, including truncation logic and boundary conditions.

classes.name: IndexLengthRestrictionEnforcerTest
classes.description: Test suite for the IndexLengthRestrictionEnforcer class, verifying enforcement of length restrictions on index keys and values.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the IndexLengthRestrictionEnforcer instance before each test.

methods.name: newInstanceWithNullThingIdFails
methods.description: Ensures that creating an enforcer with a null Thing ID throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: newInstanceWithEmptyThingIdFails
methods.description: Ensures that creating an enforcer with an empty Thing ID throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: enforceRestrictionsOnViolation
methods.description: Verifies that values exceeding the max allowed length are truncated appropriately, without truncating more than necessary.

methods.name: doNotTruncateWithoutViolation
methods.description: Checks that values within the allowed length are not truncated.

methods.name: giveUpIfKeyIsTooLong
methods.description: Ensures the method returns empty (no enforcement) when the key length exceeds the maximum allowed length.
